title: ARCHIMED Life Science Tools & Services Completes Acquisition of Standard BioTools’ Microfluidics Business, Now Biomark Scientific
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Standard BioTools Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
**Business will operate as Biomark Scientific, a leader in accessible, scalable and automated genomic workflows powered by proprietary microfluidics technology**


BOSTON, Mass., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Global private equity healthcare specialist ARCHIMED, and Standard BioTools Inc. (NASDAQ: LAB) (“Standard BioTools”), today announced the completion of ARCHIMED’s previously announced acquisition of Standard BioTools’ Microfluidics Business. As part of ARCHIMED, the business enters its next chapter as a standalone business under the name Biomark Scientific.


Biomark Scientific, an innovative microfluidics technology tools provider specializing in high-throughput and multi-assay genomics systems, will offer versatile and scalable genomic profiling on its flagship Biomark™ platform. The next-generation Biomark X9 system is the only automated PCR, qPCR and NGS library prep system on the market, performing simultaneous profiling of multiple types of genomic assay readouts in a single run using patented integrated fluidic circuits (IFCs).


A highly regarded brand in high-throughput genomic workflows serving research institutions, public health laboratories and biobanks, Biomark was previously part of Fluidigm, which was founded in 1999 and renamed Standard BioTools in 2022. As Biomark Scientific, the business will continue to offer its automated bench-top system that can run genomics assays with robustness, speed and precision, driving quality insights for critical, time-sensitive data.


Within ARCHIMED, Biomark Scientific plans to build on its established technology, expertise and deep customer relationships, while expanding its capabilities and supporting scientific discovery across genomics, clinical research and public health. The company will be an independent entity comprised of the same dedicated team and supported by enhanced capabilities to provide seamless continuity of the products and services that customers and partners trust.


“This is an exciting step forward for our organization, strengthening our ability to serve and support our customers and partners,” says Luke Stewart, newly appointed Chief Commercial Officer of Biomark Scientific. “Together with ARCHIMED, expanding our resources and investing in our expertise reflects our continued commitment to delivering greater value to our customers, with the reliability and quality they depend on. This partnership enables us to confidently move into this next phase while staying true to our foundation of scientific excellence and exceptional service, all in support of advancing genomics and improving public health.”


“With Biomark Scientific’s accelerating position in the clinical research and public health markets, we are poised to support the company in fortifying global growth and launching the business as a primary player in the industry,” says Michael Goetter at ARCHIMED. “Biomark Scientific is comprised of an amazing team, well-positioned to maintain their current momentum with the rigor and meticulous drive that has instilled loyalty among the genomics community.”


**About ARCHIMED**


With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Animal & Environmental Health, Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Diagnostics, Healthcare IT, Life Science Tools & Services, and MedTech. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €15 billion across its various funds. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.


**About Standard BioTools Inc.**


Standard BioTools Inc. (NASDAQ: LAB), is committed to setting the new standard in the life science tools industry through strategic consolidation, best-in-class operations and a world class management team. Standard BioTools’ established portfolio includes essential, standardized next-generation solutions designed to help biomedical researchers develop better therapeutics faster.
